envelope.description: IndexQueue runs an index lane and a summary lane at the same time

body.title: IndexQueue runs an index lane and a summary lane at the same time
body.summary: IndexQueue routes doc-summarise-repo and doc-summarise-entity to a summary lane and every other kind to an index lane, with today's dedup per lane; start runs one drain loop per lane concurrently and resolves when both stop; a doc-summarise-entity job goes ahead of the first queued sweep; adds takeDocSummaryEdit, laneStatus and isStopping; depth, isProcessing and depthForRepo span both lanes and codeIndexWorkFor reads the index lane only. The existing code-index-work test asserts the index lane's order only.
acceptanceChecks: An index job enqueued while a summary job runs completes before that summary job finishes.
Each lane runs its jobs one at a time in order; kinds route to the right lane.
A single-document job goes ahead of a queued sweep and takeDocSummaryEdit removes and returns it.
depth, isProcessing, depthForRepo, codeIndexWorkFor and laneStatus report as the LLD specifies; stop ends both lanes and start resolves.
The existing queue tests pass, with queue-code-index-work asserting index-lane order only.

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/queue-lanes.test.ts: while a summary job is running and has not finished, an index job enqueued after it runs to completion; the two lanes run at the same time and each runs its jobs one at a time in order; summary kinds go to the summary lane and every other kind to the index lane; a single-document job is placed ahead of a queued sweep and takeDocSummaryEdit removes and returns it; depth, isProcessing and depthForRepo span both lanes (depthForRepo counts a queued sweep but not a single-document job), codeIndexWorkFor reads the index lane only, laneStatus reports each lane; stop ends both lanes and start resolves

src/daemon/__tests__/queue-code-index-work.test.ts: the existing test asserts the order of the index lane's in-flight jobs only, independently of summary-lane interleaving, and stops once both lanes are empty
